description: Get one listing's profile: the company's description, website, sector and industry, SEC CIK, LEI and fiscal year end, the security's ISIN and type, and the company's other listings on every covered exchange with the symbol each is read by. Pass a bare ticker for a US listing or MIC:TICKER (e.g. XETR:SIE) for one on another exchange.

ticker.description: Ticker (e.g. AAPL, BRK-B) or MIC:TICKER for a listing on another exchange (e.g. XETR:SIE).

name: GetStockProfile
title: Stock Profile
